note: Meaning labels for the existing corpus. Rule: the label is the MEANING of the whole request, not the app's policy. reads = exactly one rolling lookback ending now, of that many minutes, nothing else changing the window or its scope (a sampling cadence does not); ask = a time is named but not exactly one such window; none = no time named. Default: the app's own label (its READS and NO_TIME rows all meet the rule). Overrides: rows the app REFUSES for its grammar although the whole request names one exact lookback. A bare duration with no last/past anchor ('for 90 minutes') stays ask: nothing anchors it to now. 'previous' and 'preceding' stay ask: they may name the clock hour before, or a window before another one. Written before any full run.
